notes.title: Rogue Titan Demo is LIVE!
notes.content:
[h3]Rogue Titan Demo is LIVE! 🛡️🔥[/h3]

[h3]After weeks of hard work (and plenty of sleepless nights), we’re excited to announce that the Rogue Titan demo is officially live on Steam![/h3]

[previewyoutube=QZO1qFF1Uqg;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]We know the game is challenging[/b] and crafted for a niche audience, but we’re incredibly proud of the quality and depth we’ve poured into it. With tons of changes and improvements, now is the perfect time to jump in and experience it yourself!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45129207/9a25189c0d6cc51748f1b67a02ace27850c5e74c.jpg[/img]

We’re also participating in the [b]Steam Turn-Based RPG Fest[/b] right now, and we can’t wait to connect with players who appreciate tactical depth and mythological storytelling. If you love challenging, strategic games that reward careful planning and execution, then Rogue Titan is for you!

[h3]Give it a try, and let us know your thoughts![/h3]

notes.title: Rogue Titan Demo is Almost Ready!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45129207/f58dae4952815014d0635dd956c43605c5d182e0.png[/img]

[h3]Hey everyone! We’ve got some big news we’ve been itching to share![/h3]
The Rogue Titan demo is almost ready! Mark your calendars because you can dive into the action during the Turn-Based RPG Fest, running from September 30th to October 7th!

[b]In the demo, you’ll get to explore the complete first chapter, fully playable, and choose between 3 archetypes to suit your style:[/b]
⚔️ Warrior – for those who love close combat and brute strength.
🏹 Ranger – utilizing a pet bear 🐻 and striking from a distance.
🔥 Fire Mage – master the fire element and burn your enemies with powerful spells.

[img]https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3101240/extras/Gif_D_1.gif?t=1727109419[/img]

We’ve poured our hearts into this game, and we can’t wait to see what you think. 
[b]Wishlist and prepare yourself. Rogue Titan won’t go easy on you![/b]
